name: Bankwest
legalName: Bankwest, a division of Commonwealth Bank of Australia

assessmentBufferPct.note: Not published publicly. The Bankwest Broker Portal hosts 'Policy Search' behind a login; the public broker help centre only offers a retail credit hotline for policy questions.

assessmentFloorRatePct.note: Not published publicly; broker portal login required.

rentShadingPct.note: Rental income shading is not published publicly.

maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
maxLvrOwnerOccupiedPct.note: Derived from the published owner-occupied P&I rate table, whose tiers run 'Up to 60% LVR', 'Up to 80% LVR', 'Up to 90% LVR including LMI', 'Up to 95% LVR including LMI' and a further 'Up to 98% LVR including LMI' tier. 95% is recorded as the base ceiling on the reading that the 98% tier reflects capitalised LMI on top of a 95% LVR; Bankwest does not state a maximum LVR in words. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLvrInvestmentPct.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
maxLvrInvestmentPct.note: Derived from the published investment P&I rate table, whose highest tier is 'Up to 95% LVR including LMI' (there is no 98% investment tier). Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLvrNoLmiPct.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
maxLvrNoLmiPct.note: The rate tables switch from 'Up to 80% LVR' to 'Up to 90% LVR including LMI' - i.e. LMI first appears above 80% LVR. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

lmiInclusiveOfMaxLvr.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
lmiInclusiveOfMaxLvr.note: Rate tiers above 80% are labelled 'including LMI'. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

notes.value: Owner-occupied P&I rate tiers published as at 2026-07-29: up to 60% LVR, up to 80% LVR, up to 90% LVR including LMI, up to 95% LVR including LMI, up to 98% LVR including LMI. Investment P&I tiers: up to 60%, up to 80%, up to 90% including LMI, up to 95% including LMI.
notes.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
notes.note: Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

minLoanAmount.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
minLoanAmount.note: Bankwest Simple Home Loan: 'Minimum loan $20,000'. The Complete Variable Home Loan has a minimum loan of $200,000. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxLoanTermYears.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
maxLoanTermYears.note: 'Maximum loan term 30 years' for both the Simple Home Loan and the Complete Variable Home Loan. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

maxInterestOnlyYearsOwnerOcc.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
maxInterestOnlyYearsOwnerOcc.note: Product comparison row: 'Interest only - Up to 5 years available' for both products. The page does not distinguish owner-occupied from investment interest-only terms. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

offsetAvailable.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
offsetAvailable.note: 100% offset available on both products; Simple Home Loan charges $10 per offset account per month, Complete Variable Home Loan allows up to nine offset accounts with no monthly offset fee. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

redrawAvailable.sourceTitle: Bankwest variable rate home loans (product comparison and rate tables)
redrawAvailable.note: 'Redraw Available', $0 redraw fee, on both products. Live product page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

governmentSchemesSupported.sourceTitle: Housing Australia - Australian Government 5% Deposit Scheme Participating Lenders
governmentSchemesSupported.note: Bankwest does not appear on the Housing Australia participating lender list as at 2026-07-29. Page carries no publication date; retrieved 2026-07-29.

gaps: Bankwest publishes no public credit policy: the broker site's 'Policy Search' is inside the Broker Portal login, and the public broker help centre only lists customer-facing PDS/information sheets (most dated 2014-2022) plus a retail credit hotline.
No published assessment buffer, floor rate, DTI cap, rent shading, credit card assessment rate or HEM basis.
Maximum LVRs are inferred from published rate-card tiers, not from a policy statement; whether the 98% owner-occupied tier is a genuine 98% LVR or 95% plus capitalised LMI could not be confirmed.
No published income-type table, employment tenure minimums, credit knock-outs, LMI waiver professions, security/postcode restrictions or residency/visa rules.
